ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the map of a certain region of the world (the dashed line is the January 0°C isotherm of the place). <image1> What are the climate characteristics in July in most parts of the region shown?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is marked with the 0° and 10°E meridians and the 50°N parallel, and the coastline outline shows that this region is located near western to central Europe, close to the ocean; the dashed line in the figure is labeled as the January 0°C isotherm, curving through this region. Then reason: most of this region is located near Western Europe, is obviously influenced by the Atlantic Ocean and the prevailing westerlies, and mainly belongs to a temperate oceanic climate. Although July is summer, the latitude is relatively high and the oceanic regulating effect is strong, so the temperature is not high, while precipitation is relatively abundant and the air is humid. Therefore, the climate characteristics in July are cool and humid.

<image1>

What are the climate characteristics in July in most parts of the region shown?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图示有0°、10°E经线和50°N纬线，海岸线显示该地在欧洲西部/中部附近，靠近海洋，虚线为一月0°C等温线。再根据文字要求判断“七月的气候特征”。把该区域定位为受海洋影响强的西欧一带，判定其主要气候类型偏温带海洋性；七月虽为夏季，但因纬度较高且海洋调节强，气温较低、降水仍较多，所以答案为凉爽湿润。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中标有0°、10°E经线和50°N纬线，海岸线轮廓显示该区域位于欧洲西部到中部附近，靠近海洋；图中虚线标注为一月0°C等温线，弯曲穿过该区域。再推理：该区域大部分位于西欧附近，受大西洋和盛行西风影响明显，主要属于温带海洋性气候。七月虽是夏季，但纬度较高且海洋调节作用强，气温不高，同时降水较多、空气湿润。因此七月的气候特征为凉爽湿润。

planner_metadata.image_role: 从图中读取经线0°、10°E和纬线50°N，观察区域位于欧洲西部至中部、临近北海/大西洋海域，且大部分地区在中高纬度；同时注意虚线标注为1月0°C等温线。
